name: Mondschein
beschreibung: Hotel Mondschein is located in Innsbruck's Old Town, close to the most important sights such as the Goldenes Dachl. The surroundings are urban and offer direct connections to public transport as well as shopping opportunities. The amenities include comfortable rooms, a restaurant, and a breakfast area, among other things. The style of the house combines traditional Tyrolean elements with modern accents, creating a contemporary atmosphere. The guest mix is diverse, ranging from those interested in culture to business travelers. In culinary terms, the in-house restaurant offers regional dishes as well as international classics. The furnishings are practically oriented toward a relaxing or business stay.
